description: Pinned upstream source manifest for the Pocket Realm offline build. Every active entry has an exact commit, license, and redistribution verdict. The canonical architecture and delivery reference is docs/SPP_Classics_WoW_1.12.1_Android_Port_Report.docx; this file governs source selection only.

native_build_host.msys2_env: MSYS2_ROOT / MSYS_HOME (machine-local; default G:\msys64). Complete Unix-style perl for OpenSSL, gcc for Boost b2 bootstrap.
native_build_host.ndk_junction: SDK\ndk-link -> currently-selected SDK\ndk\<version>, recreated if stale (avoids Windows 8.3 short-name path mismatch in OpenSSL toolchain detection)

dependencies_built.boost: 1.86.0 (program_options, thread, regex, serialization, filesystem, system; static runtime)
dependencies_built.sqlite: 3.46.1 amalgamation (historical O03/O04 exploratory backend; not the production database baseline)

native_build_host.playerbots_integration: BUILD_PLAYERBOTS=ON; cmangos FetchContent (SOURCE_DIR form) reads native/playerbots mirrored into native/cmangos/src/modules/PlayerBots by build_native.py ensure_playerbots()
native_build_host.emulator_test_abi: x86_64 is the required G1/G2 development and integration ABI via the fixed Android AVD lanes. arm64-v8a remains the physical release ABI; any distributed x86 artifact must be explicitly declared by the release matrix.
native_build_host.planned_database_dependency: Pinned native MariaDB source/build is selected and added by O08 before G2 acceptance.

sources.commit_date: 2026-08-01 (upstream base plus Pocket Realm Android, FetchContent, and O04 lifecycle commits)
sources.role: Vanilla 1.12 game server core (mangosd + realmd). Built for x86_64 development and arm64-v8a release. O04's embeddable lifecycle is retained as library-lane evidence; G0 selects the production component topology.

redistribution.notes: GPL-2.0 source may be redistributed. Compiled server binaries are linked by the Android app under GPL terms. The server is never translated; only the user-supplied client runs under translation.

sources.role: Pinned Classic-DB schemas/content used with the native MariaDB baseline, compatibility manifest, and migration ledger in O08-O09.
sources.license: GPL-3.0-or-later (code); content is Blizzard copyrighted material

redistribution.notes: The SQL/code is GPL-3.0. The game content has separate copyright risk and requires the report's legal/distribution gate. Client-derived DBC/maps/vmaps/mmaps come only from the user's managed client in O11 and are never bundled. See DECISIONS.md and report section 4.

sources.role: Bot subsystem enabled only after the MariaDB-backed zero-bot G3 gate; measured tiers and admission control are O13.

redistribution.notes: GPL-2.0, inherits CMaNGOS licensing. Linked into the native world component selected by the G0 topology.

verification.rule: A firmware, driver, NDK, or upstream change invalidates affected qualification and requires a new reviewed entry with re-verification.
